skill.name: performance-engineer
skill.description: Expert performance engineer specializing in modern observability, application optimization, and scalable system performance. Masters OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, load testing, multi-tier caching, Core Web Vitals, and performance monitoring. Handles end-to-end optimization, real user monitoring, and scalability patterns. Use PROACTIVELY for performance optimization, observability, or scalability challenges.
skill.summary: Guides performance diagnosis, observability, load testing, caching, and scalability planning.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive. SKILL.md line 36 warns against production load testing without approvals and safeguards. No evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or unauthorized command guidance was found.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid load testing production without approvals and safeguards.

finding_verdicts.reason: The flagged line is a safety restriction: it tells users to avoid production load testing without approvals and safeguards. It does not instruct reconnaissance or unauthorized system probing.

content.value_statement: Slow systems hurt users, reliability, and cloud costs. This skill helps diagnose bottlenecks, design tests, and plan measured optimizations.
actual_capabilities: Defines performance goals, baselines, and user impact metrics.
Guides trace, profile, and load test analysis across application layers.
Recommends caching, database, frontend, backend, and cloud optimization strategies.
Plans observability with metrics, tracing, dashboards, SLOs, and alerts.
Designs validation steps, rollout plans, and performance regression guardrails.
limitations: Requires real metrics, traces, profiles, or test results for precise diagnosis.
Does not run load tests or access monitoring tools by itself.
Recommendations still need review against production risk and business priorities.
Benchmark results depend on realistic workloads, environments, and data.

use_cases.title: Diagnose API Latency
use_cases.description: Analyze traces, profiles, and database metrics to find the highest impact latency bottlenecks.

use_cases.title: Improve Web Vitals
use_cases.description: Prioritize frontend changes that improve LCP, CLS, responsiveness, and perceived user speed.

use_cases.title: Plan Capacity Tests
use_cases.description: Design safe load tests, success criteria, and scaling plans for services before traffic growth.

prompt_templates.title: Find Slow Paths
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these latency metrics and traces. Identify likely bottlenecks, missing data, and the first three checks to run.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for a slow service

prompt_templates.title: Create a Load Test Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a load test plan for this service. Include traffic model, test stages, guardrails, success metrics, and rollback criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Core Web Vitals
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these page performance results. Recommend prioritized fixes for LCP, CLS, input latency, JavaScript cost, and image delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Observability Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an end-to-end performance observability strategy for this architecture. Cover traces, metrics, logs, SLOs, dashboards, and alerts.

output_examples.input: An API has rising p95 latency after a traffic increase.
output: Trace and profile checks to confirm the cause.
Optimization options with expected impact and tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: A React page fails Core Web Vitals targets.
output: Actions for image delivery, JavaScript reduction, and layout stability.
Validation steps using lab and real user measurements.

output_examples.input: A team needs a safe load test before a launch.
output: A staged test profile with traffic assumptions.
Production safety guardrails and approval checkpoints.
Pass, fail, and rollback criteria tied to SLOs.

best_practices: Start with clear user impact goals and baseline measurements.
Validate every optimization with repeatable tests and production monitoring.
Use approvals and safeguards before any production load testing.
anti_patterns: Optimizing without traces, profiles, or reliable baseline metrics.
Treating synthetic benchmarks as the only measure of user experience.
Adding cache layers without clear invalidation and observability plans.

faq.question: What systems does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports frontend, backend, database, cloud, mobile, and distributed system performance analysis.

faq.question: Can it run performance tests?
faq.answer: No. It helps design and analyze tests, but execution depends on your tools and environment.

faq.question: Does it require observability data?
faq.answer: Good data is strongly recommended. Metrics, traces, logs, and profiles make recommendations more accurate.

faq.question: Can it help with Core Web Vitals?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prioritize improvements for loading speed, layout stability, responsiveness, and resource cost.

faq.question: Is it safe for production systems?
faq.answer: It emphasizes safeguards, staged rollout, rollback plans, and approval before risky production testing.

faq.question: Can it reduce cloud costs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can identify right-sizing, caching, scaling, and resource efficiency opportunities.
